headline: Meloni abolishes the car tax for one year | public finances now function as an electoral ATM
summary: The Italian government has decided to suspend payment of the car tax, known as bollo auto, for one year. The measure applies to all vehicles and is part of a package of fiscal interventions.
why: Vehicle taxes are a component of Italian public revenue, so changes to them affect government finances and household costs.
